description: This file contains the implementation of the VectorizedDeltaLengthByteArrayReader class, which is a vectorized decoder for Parquet's DELTA_LENGTH_BYTE_ARRAY data type, used within Spark's Parquet data source for efficient binary data reading.

classes.name: VectorizedDeltaLengthByteArrayReader
classes.description: A vectorized Parquet decoder for DELTA_LENGTH_BYTE_ARRAY data, supporting efficient binary data reading within Spark.

methods.name: initFromPage
methods.description: Initializes the reader with a page of data, setting up the lengths vector and input stream.

methods.name: readBinary
methods.description: Reads binary data for a specified number of rows into a column vector.

methods.name: getBytes
methods.description: Retrieves the byte buffer for a specific row's binary data.

methods.name: skipBinary
methods.description: Skips over a specified number of binary entries in the input stream.
